pages.text: The Security Manager is a critical block for managing access to your Refined Storage network. It stores security cards and allows you to configure permissions for each player linked with a $(l:security_card)Security Card$(). By inserting a Security Card into the top slots, you can restrict a player's permissions to those configured in the GUI.$(br2)Behavior$(br)When no security cards are active on the network, all players have full access. Insert security cards to define specific permissions for players. Players without a configured Security Card retain full access. To set global permissions for unconfigured players, insert an unbound Security Card into the Security Manager.

When no security cards are active on the network, everyone has access to all permissions. Start inserting security cards to define permissions for players. Players who have no configured Security Card are still able to do everything in the network (all permissions). To configure a "global" set of permissions for all unconfigured players, configure a Security Card that isn't bound to a player and insert it in the Security Manager.

Security Cards define access levels:$(br)$(li)Owner - Full access$(li)Operator - Management access$(li)User - Basic access$(li)Viewer - View only$(br2)Cards can be configured with specific permissions.
